title: Anthropic's $10B Funding & Nvidia's Revenue Milestone — 2026-01-12
description: In today's episode, we explore Anthropic's massive $10 billion funding round which values the company at a staggering $350 billion. What implications does this have for the AI landscape? We also delve into Nvidia's path to reaching a $200 billion revenue milestone, driven by its Blackwell and China H200 chip sales. Additionally, we'll touch on how Nvidia's CEO managed to both criticize and praise Trump in the same breath over policies affecting $10.5 billion in revenue. Plus, get a sneak peek at the eight most anticipated US tech IPOs of 2026 and TSMC's impressive Q4 profit surge fueled by AI demand.
